claim: When a group uses the $Latest or $Default launch template version, later launches use that version, even if it has changed, with the permissions of the service-linked role, so a user who can update the template could pass an IAM role to instances without iam:PassRole; the autoscaling:LaunchTemplateVersionSpecified condition key limits who can configure groups to use $Latest or $Default.

evidence.quote: This means that a user who is using the launch template could potentially update it to pass an IAM role to an instance even if they don't have the `iam:PassRole` permission.
evidence.title: Control Amazon EC2 launch template usage in Auto Scaling groups

evidence.quote: Use the `autoscaling:LaunchTemplateVersionSpecified` condition key if you want to limit who has access to configuring groups to use the `$Latest` or `$Default` version.
evidence.title: Control Amazon EC2 launch template usage in Auto Scaling groups
Control Amazon EC2 launch template usage in Auto Scaling groups
evidence.quote: After the initial verification and request are complete, whenever instances launch, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling launches them with the latest or default version, even if it has changed, using the permissions of its [service-linked role](autoscaling-service-linked-role.md#service-linked-role-permissions).
